## About Page (about.html)

**Title:** About Us | SJ Landscapes — Maidenhead Landscaping Specialists
**Meta description:** Meet Samuel Simmonds, founder of SJ Landscapes. Maidenhead-based landscaping and outdoor construction specialists serving Berkshire and surrounding areas.

### Content

SJ Landscapes was founded by Samuel Simmonds with a simple belief — that every outdoor space deserves to be built properly, using the right materials, with the care and attention it takes to make it last.

Based in Maidenhead and covering Berkshire and surrounding areas, we handle everything from single driveways and patios to complete garden transformations. Whatever the scale of your project, you get the same thing: honest advice, quality workmanship, and a result you'll be proud of.

We're not a large contractor with dozens of crews — every job gets Samuel's direct involvement. That means consistent quality, clear communication, and someone who genuinely cares about the outcome from day one to handover.

### Values

- **Premium Materials:** We only use materials built to last in the British climate — no corners cut, no cheap substitutes.
- **Clear Communication:** You'll always know what's happening, what's next, and how your project is progressing.
- **Local Knowledge:** We know Maidenhead and Berkshire — the soil, the weather, the planning considerations that matter.
- **Finish Line Focus:** The job isn't done until you're completely happy. We stay until the result is right.

## Services Page (services.html)

**Title:** Services | SJ Landscapes — Block Paving, Patios & Landscaping in Maidenhead
**Meta description:** Full landscaping and outdoor construction services in Maidenhead and Berkshire. Block paving, patios, garden design, pergolas, fencing, summerhouses, artificial lawns and more.

### Block Paving (#block-paving)

Transform your driveway, path, or patio with quality block paving. We work with a full range of block types — standard concrete, tegula, tumbled cobbles, and more — all professionally laid on a proper sub-base for a finish that lasts. Based in Maidenhead, we complete block paving projects across Berkshire.

### Patios (#patios)

A well-designed patio adds real value to your home and extends your living space outdoors. We install patios in natural stone, porcelain, sandstone, limestone, and Indian sandstone — all properly bedded and pointed. From compact seating areas to large entertaining spaces across Maidenhead and Berkshire.

### Landscape Design & Build (#landscape-design)

Full garden transformations from start to finish. We handle the design, groundworks, hard landscaping, planting, and finishing — everything managed under one roof. Whether you want a low-maintenance modern garden or a lush, layered outdoor space, we'll design and build it to your brief across Berkshire and surrounding areas.

### Pergolas (#pergolas)

A pergola creates a defined outdoor room — perfect for dining, relaxing, or entertaining. We build pergolas in timber and aluminium, freestanding or wall-mounted, with optional integrated lighting and climbing plant trellis. Fully bespoke to your garden's dimensions and style. Serving Maidenhead, Windsor, Marlow and across Berkshire.

### Fencing & Gates (#fencing)

Quality fencing and gate installation for privacy, security, and kerb appeal. We install close-board, feather-edge, trellis, and timber panel fencing, plus bespoke timber and metal gates. All posts are properly set in concrete for a fence that stays upright for years. Covering Maidenhead, Berkshire and surrounding areas.

### Summerhouse Builds (#summerhouses)

A summerhouse adds usable space to your garden — ideal as a home office, studio, gym, or relaxation space. We design and build custom summerhouses to suit your garden and budget, handling foundations, structure, cladding, roofing, and internal finishing. Built to last across Berkshire's climate.

### Artificial & Real Turf Lawns (#lawns)

Whether you want the low-maintenance look of premium artificial grass or the natural feel of freshly laid turf, we install both to a high standard. Artificial lawns are installed on a proper aggregate base with good drainage — not just on soil. Real turf is sourced from quality suppliers and laid on prepared topsoil. Serving Maidenhead and Berkshire.

### Garage & Loft Conversions (#conversions)

Make the most of the space you already have. We convert garages and lofts into usable living space — home offices, playrooms, guest bedrooms, and more. Full conversion service including structural work, insulation, plastering, and finishing. Covering Maidenhead, Berkshire and surrounding areas.
